raw.text: You rented the flat from Tan Ah Kow and paid him a $2,600 deposit on 3 August 2025, with the agreement stating he must refund it within 14 days after you move out, minus any damage. You moved out on 31 July 2026, left the keys in the mailbox as he told you to, and cleaned the flat, and he replied "Received" and said "ok, all good. will transfer deposit after i check." The 14 days was up on 14 August 2026, but on 15 August 2026 he said the sofa had a scratch and refused to return the deposit, and even after you asked him on 20 August 2026 to send a photo of the scratch and to return the $2,600 if there was no damage, he still has not paid you back.

On 3 Aug 2025, I signed a tenancy agreement with my landlord, Mr Tan Ah Kow, for an HDB flat. I paid him a security deposit of $2,600 by bank transfer. The agreement says he must refund the deposit within 14 days after I move out, minus any damage cost.

On 31 Jul 2026, I moved out. I cleaned the flat and left the keys in the mailbox as he told me to. He replied "ok, all good" and said he would transfer the deposit after checking the flat.

14 days passed on 14 Aug 2026, but he did not refund the deposit.

On 15 Aug 2026, I asked him to transfer the deposit since 14 days had passed. He then said the sofa had a scratch and refused to return the deposit until this was settled.

On 20 Aug 2026, I asked him to send a photo of the alleged scratch and to return my $2,600 if there was no damage. He has not returned my deposit.

I am claiming $2,600 for the unreturned security deposit.
